meaning.en: to feel pride in someone or in an achievement
meaning.de: Stolz auf jemanden oder auf eine Leistung empfinden

usage.en: proud of sb/sth/yourself · proud to + verb · proud (that) + clause. ✗ proud with. The negative expresses regret: "I'm not proud of it."
usage.tr: proud of sb/sth/yourself · proud to + fiil · proud (that) + cümle. ✗ proud with. Olumsuzu pişmanlık bildirir: "I'm not proud of it."

sentences.en: I'm so [proud of] you — you worked really hard for this.
sentences.tr: Seninle gurur duyuyorum, bunun için çok emek verdin.
sentences.de: Ich bin so stolz auf dich – du hast wirklich hart dafür gearbeitet.

sentences.en: I'm not [proud of] how I handled it.
sentences.tr: O durumu ele alış biçimimle övünmüyorum.
sentences.de: Ich bin nicht stolz darauf, wie ich damit umgegangen bin.

meaning.en: to be satisfied with a result

variety.en: AmE + BrE ("pleased" is more common in BrE)

usage.en: pleased/happy with + result, thing · pleased/happy about + situation · pleased for sb (glad on their behalf)
usage.tr: pleased/happy with + sonuç, nesne · pleased/happy about + durum · pleased for sb (onun adına sevinmek)

sentences.en: I'm really [pleased with] how the presentation turned out.
sentences.tr: Sunumun sonucundan çok memnunum.
sentences.de: Ich bin wirklich zufrieden damit, wie die Präsentation geworden ist.

sentences.en: Are you [happy with] your grade?
sentences.tr: Notundan memnun musun?
sentences.de: Bist du mit deiner Note zufrieden?

meaning.en: (1) to believe something will go well (2) to feel that what you did was right
meaning.tr: (1) bir şeyin iyi gideceğine inanmak (2) yaptığı şey içine sinmek
meaning.de: (1) glauben, dass etwas gut ausgeht (2) das Gefühl haben, richtig gehandelt zu haben

equivalent.tr: içi rahat olmak, içine sinmek, iyi hissetmek
equivalent.de: ein gutes Gefühl bei etwas haben

usage.en: feel good about sth/V-ing · have a good feeling about sth. The negative signals a troubled conscience: "I don't feel good about it."
usage.tr: feel good about sth/V-ing · have a good feeling about sth. Olumsuzu vicdan rahatsızlığı: "I don't feel good about it."

sentences.en: I [feel really good about] the interview.
sentences.tr: Mülakat konusunda içim çok rahat.
sentences.de: Ich habe ein richtig gutes Gefühl bei dem Vorstellungsgespräch.

sentences.en: I don't [feel good about] lying to her.
sentences.tr: Ona yalan söylemek içime sinmiyor.
sentences.de: Ich habe kein gutes Gefühl dabei, sie anzulügen.

meaning.en: to trust yourself or an outcome
meaning.tr: kendine ya da bir sonuca güvenmek
meaning.de: sich selbst oder einem Ergebnis vertrauen

usage.en: confident about + result/event · confident in + ability/person · confident (that) + clause. Noun: confidence. For personality: self-confident.
usage.tr: confident about + sonuç/olay · confident in + yetenek/kişi · confident (that) + cümle. İsim: confidence. Kişilik için: self-confident.

sentences.en: I'm pretty [confident about] tomorrow's exam.
sentences.tr: Yarınki sınav konusunda kendime bayağı güveniyorum.
sentences.de: Ich bin ziemlich zuversichtlich, was die Prüfung morgen angeht.

sentences.en: She's a lot more [confident in] her English now.
sentences.tr: Artık İngilizcesine çok daha fazla güveniyor.
sentences.de: Sie ist jetzt viel sicherer in ihrem Englisch.

meaning.en: to be sure you can handle something; to encourage someone
meaning.tr: bir işi halledebileceğinden emin olmak; birine moral vermek
meaning.de: sicher sein, etwas zu schaffen; jemandem Mut machen

equivalent.de: Ich mach das schon. / Du schaffst das!

usage.en: I've got this. (I'll handle it) · You've got this! (you can do it) · We've got this. In speech: "I got this."
usage.tr: I've got this. (ben hallederim) · You've got this! (yapabilirsin) · We've got this. Konuşmada: "I got this."

sentences.en: Don't worry, I've [got this].
sentences.tr: Merak etme, ben hallederim.
sentences.de: Keine Sorge, ich mach das schon.

sentences.en: You've [got this]! You've practised a hundred times.
sentences.tr: Yaparsın sen! Yüz kere prova ettin.
sentences.de: Du schaffst das! Du hast es hundertmal geübt.

expressions.expr: nail it / kill it / smash it

equivalent.tr: on numara yapmak, çok iyi kotarmak, döktürmek
equivalent.de: etwas rocken, etwas mit Bravour meistern

literal.en: to hit the nail exactly · to kill · to smash

variety.en: nail it, kill it: AmE + BrE · smash it: BrE
variety.tr: nail it, kill it: AmE + BrE · smash it: BrE

usage.en: nail + noun (nail the interview) · "Nailed it!" (also ironic) · be killing it (ongoing success)
usage.tr: nail + isim (nail the interview) · "Nailed it!" (ironik de kullanılır) · be killing it (süregelen başarı)

sentences.en: You [nailed] that presentation!
sentences.tr: O sunumu harika yaptın!
sentences.de: Die Präsentation hast du gerockt!

sentences.en: She's absolutely [killing it] at her new job.
sentences.tr: Yeni işinde resmen döktürüyor.
sentences.de: In ihrem neuen Job macht sie sich absolut großartig.

meaning.en: to succeed at something difficult or risky; (of clothes/style) to be able to carry it
meaning.de: etwas Schwieriges oder Riskantes schaffen; (von Kleidung/Stil) etwas tragen können

equivalent.de: etwas hinkriegen, etwas schaffen; sich etwas leisten können

usage.en: pull sth off (separable; pronoun in the middle: pull it off). Carries a tone of unexpected success.
usage.tr: pull sth off (ayrılabilir; zamir ortada: pull it off). Beklenmedik başarı tonu vardır.

sentences.en: I didn't think we'd finish on time, but somehow we [pulled it off].
sentences.tr: Zamanında bitireceğimizi sanmıyordum ama bir şekilde başardık.
sentences.de: Ich dachte nicht, dass wir rechtzeitig fertig werden, aber irgendwie haben wir es hingekriegt.

sentences.en: Not many people can [pull off] a yellow suit, but he does.
sentences.tr: Sarı takımı herkes taşıyamaz ama o taşıyor.
sentences.de: Nicht viele können einen gelben Anzug tragen, aber ihm steht er.

meaning.en: to have one success after another; to be in form
meaning.tr: üst üste başarı yakalamak, formda olmak
meaning.de: einen Erfolg nach dem anderen haben; in Form sein

equivalent.tr: formunda olmak, şansı açık olmak, gaza gelmiş gitmek
equivalent.de: einen Lauf haben, eine Glückssträhne haben

usage.en: be on a roll. Usually present tense.
usage.tr: be on a roll. Genellikle şimdiki zamanla.

sentences.en: Three wins in a row — we're [on a roll]!
sentences.tr: Üst üste üç galibiyet, fırtına gibi gidiyoruz!
sentences.de: Drei Siege in Folge – wir haben einen Lauf!

sentences.en: Don't stop me now, I'm [on a roll].
sentences.tr: Durdurma beni, tam havamı bulmuşum.
sentences.de: Halt mich jetzt nicht auf, ich bin gerade so richtig in Fahrt.

expressions.expr: be full of oneself / be cocky

meaning.en: to think too highly of yourself; to be annoyingly over-confident
meaning.tr: kendini fazla beğenmek; rahatsız edici derecede özgüvenli olmak
meaning.de: zu viel von sich halten; nervig übertrieben selbstsicher sein

equivalent.tr: kendini beğenmiş olmak, burnu havada olmak; ukala olmak
equivalent.de: eingebildet sein, von sich eingenommen sein; großspurig sein

literal.en: to be filled with yourself · cock = rooster

usage.en: be full of yourself (personality) · be/get cocky (attitude in the moment). confident is positive; cocky and full of himself are negative.
usage.tr: be full of yourself (kişilik) · be/get cocky (o anki tavır). confident olumlu; cocky ve full of himself olumsuzdur.

sentences.en: He's so [full of himself] — he only ever talks about his own achievements.
sentences.tr: Çok kendini beğenmiş, hep kendi başarılarını anlatıyor.
sentences.de: Er ist so von sich eingenommen – er redet immer nur über seine eigenen Erfolge.

sentences.en: Don't get [cocky] — it was only the first round.
sentences.tr: Hemen havaya girme, daha ilk turdu.
sentences.de: Werd nicht übermütig – das war erst die erste Runde.

meaning.en: to try to impress people; to boast

literal.en: show = to display; off = outward, on display

usage.en: show off (intransitive: boast, negative) · show sth off (transitive: display proudly, neutral) · a show-off (noun) · brag about sth · "Not to brag, but…"
usage.tr: show off (geçişsiz: hava atmak, olumsuz) · show sth off (geçişli: gururla göstermek, nötr) · a show-off (isim) · brag about sth · "Not to brag, but…"

sentences.en: He's just [showing off] in front of his friends.
sentences.tr: Arkadaşlarının önünde hava atıyor sadece.
sentences.de: Er gibt nur vor seinen Freunden an.

sentences.en: Not to [brag], but I got the highest mark in the class.
sentences.tr: Övünmek gibi olmasın ama sınıfın en yüksek notunu aldım.
sentences.de: Ich will ja nicht angeben, aber ich hatte die beste Note im Kurs.
